title: Многоколоночный индекс

positive.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_person_order_multi ON person_order (person_id, menu_id) INCLUDE (order_date);
EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT person_id, menu_id, order_date FROM person_order WHERE person_id = 8 AND menu_id = 14;

CREATE INDEX idx_person_order_multi ON person_order (menu_id, person_id, order_date);
EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT person_id, menu_id, order_date FROM person_order WHERE person_id = 8 AND menu_id = 14;

negative.why: нет столбца order_date: Index Only Scan невозможен
negative.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_person_order_multi ON person_order (person_id, menu_id);
EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT person_id, menu_id, order_date FROM person_order WHERE person_id = 8 AND menu_id = 14;

negative.why: столбец order_date стоит первым: условия не попадают в условия индекса
negative.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_person_order_multi ON person_order (order_date, person_id, menu_id);
EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT person_id, menu_id, order_date FROM person_order WHERE person_id = 8 AND menu_id = 14;

CREATE INDEX idx_person_order_multi ON person_order (person_id);
EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT person_id, menu_id, order_date FROM person_order WHERE person_id = 8 AND menu_id = 14;

CREATE INDEX idx_multi ON person_order (person_id, menu_id, order_date);
EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT person_id, menu_id, order_date FROM person_order WHERE person_id = 8 AND menu_id = 14;
